{{Quote|Let me propose a neutral meeting ground. Shall we say…Rugosa, yes? Three days' time. The coral moon shall do.|King Katuunko|<ref name="Prelude" />}}
'''Rugosa''', also known as the '''coral moon''', was a temperate [[Moon/Legends|moon]] in the [[Sanbra sector/Legends|Sanbra sector]]. It was one of the [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] that made up the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] power led by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in approximately [[30,000 BBY]]. The moon was later discovered by [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] working near the [[Balmorra Run/Legends|Balmorra Run]], and because of its attractive climate and warm [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]], it became a Toydarian vacation spot that they kept secret from their [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] masters. Once the Hutts discovered the Toydarians' duplicity, they punished them by releasing a [[plague]] onto the moon, drying up all its [[Water/Legends|oceans]] and exposing vast expanses of [[Rugosa land coral|coral]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Rugosa was selected as the site for [[Battle of Rugosa/Legends|negotiations]] between [[King/Legends|King]] [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]] of [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]] and representatives of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. However, when the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] intercepted communications arranging the meeting, they ambushed the Republic envoy. A small group of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], made it to the moon and engaged the Confederacy in combat, eventually defeating their forces and gaining the allegiance of King Katuunko.

==Description==
{{Quote|Beautiful, this moon, is. Amazing, the universe, is.|Master Yoda|audio=BeautifulMoonAmazingUniverse.flac|<ref name="Ambush">{{TCW|Ambush}}</ref>}}
[[File:Rugosa_land_coral.png|thumb|left|200px|A dense coral forest on Rugosa]]
Rugosa was a temperate [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] a [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="EC:A">{{SW|url=video/ambush-episode-featurette|text="Ambush" Episode Featurette}}</ref> in the [[Rugosa system/Legends|Rugosa system]]—a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Sanbra sector/Legends|Sanbra sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TEAOC" />—near the [[Balmorra Run/Legends|Balmorra Run]]. The moon was once covered in warm swamps and shallow [[Ocean/Legends|seas]]; however, a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[plague]] dried up its [[Water/Legends|oceans]],<ref name="TCWEG" /> leaving its [[Rugosa land coral|coral formations]] and reefs exposed, as well as fossil remains of native [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="EC:A" /> Many plants and coral survived the plague:<ref name="TCWEG" /> the massive coral formations varied in color, from green to blue to purple, and included various forms, from large fan-shapes to antler shapes and porous spheres. Some were large enough for [[Starship/Legends|starships]] such as the [[Peregrine-class star yacht|''Peregrine''-class star yacht]] [[Thief's Eye/Legends|''Thief's Eye'']] to comfortably land on them.<ref name="EC:A" /> A number of petrified coral formations were damaged during the [[Battle of Rugosa/Legends|battle]] that took place there during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Ambush" />

Following the Hutt plague, rainfall slowly began to accumulate in the ocean beds. Exotic fauna also arrived on the moon, and baby [[Neebray/Legends|neebray manta]] lived among the coral formations as a stop along their migration through [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="TCWEG" />

==History==
{{Quote|We've been translating the Rakata inscriptions. Most are indecipherable, but a few refer to a prisoner called "the Infernal One." We've seen the title before, in the Dead Corals of Rugosa and the Ziost Abyss. We thought it a myth—the Rakata warlord who bled and enslaved a thousand planets.|[[Threnoldt]]|audio=WhatTheRakatansCalledBillBrasky-TOR.flac|<ref name="tor">{{TORcite|type=operation|The Eternity Vault}}</ref>}}
Around the year [[30,000 BBY]], an [[Alien/Legends|alien]] species known as the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] became a significant [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] power. Using [[Force-drive|Force-based hyperdrives]], they traveled to many worlds around the galaxy that possessed significant signatures in the Force and united them to form the Rakatan [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]. Among these worlds was Rugosa,<ref name="Atlas" /> one of a thousand planets subjugated by a warlord known as "[[Soa|The Infernal One]]," whose name was inscribed in a region that became known as the [[Dead Corals]].<ref name="tor" /> After five thousand years of galactic dominance, plague caused the collapse of the Infinite Empire and, eventually, the end of the Rakata presence on the moon.<ref name="Atlas" /> "The Infernal One" who had dominated this world and many others fell into myth.<ref name="tor" />

Following the Rakatan extinction,<ref name="Atlas" /> the moon remained uninhabited for thousands of years until it was discovered by [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarians]] [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] around the Balmorra Run some centuries before the Clone Wars. The Toydarians were native to the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]<ref name="TCWEG" /> planet [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]], which was covered in muck lakes filled with dangerous predators.<ref name="Toydarian">{{DB|species|toydarian|Toydarian}}</ref> To the Toydarians, Rugosa's warm swamps and coral seas appeared a paradise. Their clan chiefs turned the moon into a vacation spot and kept its existence hidden from their Hutt [[overlord]]s. When the Hutts eventually discovered the deception, they released an ancient plague on the moon in order to punish the Toydarians. Within months, the plague dried up Rugosa's seas, turning the verdant moon into a dry world.<ref name="TCWEG" /> Consequently, it earned the nickname "the coral moon" among some Toydarians.<ref name="Ambush" />

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], researchers of the resurgent [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] referred to the Rakatan inscriptions on the Dead Corals during their exploration of the [[Eternity Vault]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] to provide clues to the identity of the Rakata imprisoned there, the legendary "Infernal One."<ref name="tor" />

===The Clone Wars===
{{SeeAlso|Mission to Rugosa}}
{{Quote|If Yoda is indeed the Jedi warrior you believe he is, let him prove it. Allow me to send my best troops to capture him. If he escapes, join the Republic. But should my droids defeat Yoda, consider an alliance with the Separatists.|Asajj Ventress, to Katuunko|audio=YodaAcceptsChallenge.flac|<ref name="Ambush" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the galaxy was engulfed by the Clone Wars fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the breakaway [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The Confederacy met success with capturing many [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]], causing the Republic to seek out alternate routes throughout the galaxy. After successfully negotiating a treaty with the Hutt [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] for safe passage through Hutt Space<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars film">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref> in 22 BBY,<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the Republic sought to secure a supply base in the region. Identifying the neutral [[Toydaria system/Legends|Toydaria system]] as a suitable location, [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of the Republic personally contacted [[King/Legends|King]] [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]] of Toydaria and requested his world's allegiance to the Republic. Wishing to ensure that his people were not coerced into giving their support, Katuunko insisted that the Republic send a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] as an envoy. When Palpatine raised concerns over sending a lone Jedi so near to enemy-controlled space, Katuunko suggested the moon Rugosa<ref name="Prelude" />—which reminded him of his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]<ref name="Ambush Decoded">{{TCW|Ambush|d=y}}</ref>—as a neutral meeting place. Palpatine agreed, and [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] was subsequently chosen to conduct the negotiations.<ref name="Prelude" /> [[Spy/Legends|Spies]] for the CIS intercepted word of the proposed meeting,<ref name="DB" /> and in order to disrupt the Republic's plan, the Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] dispatched [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]<ref name="Ambush" />—a [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|disciple]] who was trained in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] and the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]<ref name="DB-Ventress, Asajj">{{DB|character|asajjventress|Ventress, Asajj}}</ref>—to convince or coerce the Toydarian King to become a Confederate ally instead.<ref name="Ambush" />

[[File:Ventress_Katuunko.png|thumb|right|250px|Katuunko, Yoda, and Ventress negotiate on Rugosa.]]
Shortly after arriving on the moon in his personal [[Yacht/Legends|star yacht]], the ''Thief's Eye'',<ref name="Katuunko">{{DB|character|katuunko|Katuunko, King}}</ref> Katuunko and his [[Toydarian royal delegation/Legends|delegation]] were met by Ventress and a small [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]]. Ventress presented the King with a [[Hologram/Legends|holo-message]] from Count Dooku, who challenged the ability of the Jedi to protect Toydaria should the King side with the Republic. At that point, a Republic [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]] bearing [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Yoda emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] in orbit of the moon. The [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] was ambushed by two [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]], which [[Jammer/Legends|jammed]] the craft's transmissions. On Yoda's orders, the cruiser launched all its [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] before fleeing the system. One of the escape pods, containing Yoda and three [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]—[[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Thire/Legends|Thire]], [[Jek/Legends|Jek]], and [[Rys/Legends|Rys]]—crash-landed on the moon. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] Thire patched into the King's communication system, alerting Katuunko to the Jedi's survival. Faced with Yoda's presence on the moon, Ventress made a proposal: she would send her best [[Troop/Legends|troops]] to capture the Jedi. If Yoda escaped, the King would join the Republic, but should her [[Droid/Legends|droids]] defeat Yoda, the King would ally himself with the Confederacy. Yoda accepted the challenge, declaring that he would reach the King's position by nightfall.<ref name="Ambush" />

A Confederate [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] landed on the moon, disembarking<ref name="Ambush" /> an entire [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] of droid forces.<ref name="Databank">{{DB|character|jek|Jek}}, {{DB|character|rys|Rys}}, {{DB|character|commanderthire|Thire}}</ref> Under the command of [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM command battle droid]] [[224/Legends|224]],<ref name="Ambush Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode001.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Ambush}}</ref> a number of large [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]] advanced on Yoda's position; however, they were impeded by the moon's dense coral. Consequently, further droid forces were dispatched on foot. Yoda and the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] took a circuitous path to the rendezvous point, hoping in this manner to avoid some of Ventress's forces. They soon encountered two patrols of B1 battle droids, which they successfully defeated, before encountering a complement of [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]]. These, too, were dispatched by the Republic forces, although not without Thire sustaining a wound from super battle droid [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]]. A third skirmish, this time against several [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]], followed shortly thereafter, during which Master Yoda deflected their [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire into a nearby coral growth, toppling it onto the droids. While the fight was again won by the Republic, the clones had severely depleted their munitions after these three encounters and so, along with Yoda, took temporary refuge in a cave.<ref name="Ambush" />

[[File:View_from_the_mountaintop.png|thumb|left|250px|Katuunko and Ventress overlook Rugosa from a large coral formation.]]
While the Republic forces recuperated, a Separatist column of three Armored Assault [[Tank/Legends|tanks]] and assorted infantry advanced down a ravine toward the Republic position. Yoda ventured down into the canyon on his own and destroyed the three tanks and a large number of droids. As a last-ditch effort to [[Death/Legends|eliminate]] the Jedi, Ventress dispatched several droidekas as reinforcements. While the droidekas almost took the Jedi Master by surprise, they were destroyed by Thire, who launched the clones' final [[PLX-1/Legends|missile]] at a rock formation overhanging the canyon. The resulting avalanche crushed the droids.<ref name="Ambush" />

By this point, it was nearing sunset. Dooku again communicated with Katuunko by hologram. Having witnessed Master Yoda destroy an entire battalion of droid forces single-handed from afar, Katuunko declared his intention to side with the Republic. Dooku responded by ordering Ventress to kill the Toydarian. The Dark Acolyte ignited her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], swinging at the King in a killing strike. Her would-be regicide, however, was halted at the last instant by a [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force grip]] employed by Yoda, who had just arrived with the clones at the rendezvous point. Yoda then offered Ventress the chance to surrender, but she refused and triggered a nearby explosion to provide cover for her escape. Impressed with Yoda's deeds,<ref name="Ambush" /> King Katuunko allied his world with the Republic, signified by handing Yoda the [[Ceremonial sword/Legends|ceremonial sword]] of Toydaria.<ref name="Katuunko" /> The Republic forces and the Toydarian delegation were evacuated from the moon shortly thereafter with the arrival of a Republic [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]].<ref name="Ambush" />

==Inhabitants==
Rugosa was once inhabited by the Rakata.<ref name="Atlas" /> These [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] had large, cone-like heads with [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] on short stalks on the sides.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]'', 17</ref> Disease eventually caused the collapse of their civilization and the end of their presence on Rugosa.<ref name="Atlas" /> Thousands of years later, the moon was used as a vacation spot by Toydarians,<ref name="TCWEG" /> a short species with vaguely [[Bird/Legends|avian]] features and a stubby trunk. They had small wings with which they could fly, despite their tubby appearance.<ref name="Toydarian" /> Once Rugosa was ruined by Hutt plague, the Toydarians stopped using it as a vacation spot.<ref name="TCWEG" /> However, King Katuunko and his entourage visited the world during the Clone Wars.<ref name="Ambush" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|It was a new way to look at a planet in ''Star Wars''.|Dave Filoni, on creating a unique terrain for a planet|<ref name="EC:A" />}}
[[File:Rugosa_concept_art.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Concept art of Rugosa]]
Rugosa was featured in "[[Ambush]]," the first episode of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which aired on [[October 3]], [[2008]]. Rugosa has subsequently been incorporated in supporting ''The Clone Wars'' material, such as ''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]''; the latter fleshed out the history of Rugosa prior to Ambush. Rugosa has also been included in other releases such as ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.

Inspired by the [[Wikipedia:Flash Gordon|''Flash Gordon'' series]], the moon was designed so as to offer a unique terrain. In previous ''[[Star Wars]]'' movies, desert, ice, jungle, and forest planets had already been presented, so the design team settled on a coral design to offer a new environment.<ref name="EC:A" /> The word "[[Wikipedia:Rugosa|rugosa]]" itself is an extinct order of coral.<ref name="palaeos">{{WebCite|url=http://palaeos.com/metazoa/cnidaria/rugosa.htm|text=Rugosa|author=Kazlev, M.|date=2002-06-16|work=palaeos.com|archivedate=20170508070859}}</ref> The moon was initially designed with a [[red]]dish color palette; however, when it was decided to release the episode first, rather than later in the series as originally planned, Supervising Director [[Dave Filoni]] realized that the color would be too similar to that of the [[Abregado system/Legends|setting]] for "[[Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence'']]," the second episode to be released. Consequently, Filoni had Rugosa's color scheme modified to blue and green hues to create a distinct look.<ref name="DB" /> [[Russell G. Chong]], the artist who worked on illustrating the moon, is himself a scuba diver and drew on these experiences in his designs.<ref name="TCW Art">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''</ref>

According to ''The Essential Atlas'' Appendix, Rugosa is located within grid P-17. However all the maps within this book place Rugosa in O-17 as does the ''Essential Atlas'' Extra: Outer Rim Sectors feature. The 11 June 2010 update to the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion]]—which had previously repeated the ''Atlas''{{'s}} placement—corrected this error and listed its location as O-17.<ref name="TEAOC" />
